summary: Re-read the operator's pages: the 2027 rates ($50 back-in W/E/gray water, $55 and $60 pull-through; weekly and 28-day rates), 50/30-amp sites, most pads to 40 ft and five to 45 ft, Wi-Fi, showers, camp store, coin laundry all match what the entry already carries from the 2026-10-14 reads (CampLife quotes, season April 15 - October 15). Nothing new; no change. Not stated: site count, so the seasonal share can't be measured (26 nightly RV sites are sold online).
flags: Price gate (borderline): base $50/night (2027 rates page and CampLife, back-in W/E/gray water) is AT, not over, US$50; online bookings add $3 once a stay (not counted). No gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed here.
